subject: Courier & Signer Escrow — Signed Bundle Acceptance Protocol
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sterile-ops.com>, ColdChain Logistics <logistics@coldchaincouriers.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Courier & Signer Escrow — Signed Bundle Acceptance Protocol

Elena / ColdChain team,

Following up on our onboarding call: Redwood is finalizing the acceptance flow for sealed-site (air-gapped) bundle deliveries to Sterile Infrastructure. We need to lock the courier & signer escrow process so sites can accept images without introducing risk.

Key asks from Redwood: 
- Confirm courier identity verification steps and chain-of-custody handoff (photo manifest + printed manifest signed by operator).
- Confirm signer escrow options: on-site operator + secondary escrow signer (remote compliance reviewer) or notarized manifest delivered with bundle.
- Confirm KMS-binding: how the on-media KEK wrapping will be validated at acceptance time and what samples you need from us.

Attached: bundle-acceptance-checklist-v1.pdf (draft) — please review and mark required changes.

Target: agree on final checklist and a two-week pilot at one field site (preferred window 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-28).

Elena, can you reply with ColdChain's SOP and the names/IDs of approved couriers? Karthik / Marissa — please flag any non-negotiable technical constraints.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Director, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference
[attachment: bundle-acceptance-checklist-v1.pdf]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sterile-ops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ColdChain Logistics <logistics@coldchaincouriers.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Courier & Signer Escrow — Signed Bundle Acceptance Protocol

On Tue, 11 Aug 2026 at 09:12, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Following up on our onboarding call: Redwood is finalizing the acceptance flow for sealed-site (air-gapped) bundle deliveries to Sterile Infrastructure.

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear summary. Attached is our SOP and the current courier manifest template. High level:

- ColdChain uses two-person handoff and photographic proof of seal prior to handoff; the printed manifest is signed by the site operator and retained in courier custody.
- Notarized manifest is available as an add-on (requires 48h prep) and is commonly used for high-value bundles.
- For signer escrow we can support: (A) on-site operator sign + remote escrow reviewer (Redwood/ Sterile compliance) who countersigns the manifest digitally upon photo verification, or (B) notarized manifest in the sealed tote.

We require the following samples from Redwood for KEK/KMS binding verification: public key thumbprint for the signing key, sample wrapped key metadata (header with algorithm/nonce), and an example of the on-media filename schema.

Proposed acceptance windows for pilot (Sterile customer site A):
- 2026-08-24 AM (08:00–11:30 local)
- 2026-08-27 PM (13:00–16:30 local)

Attachments: sterile-courier-sop.pdf, manifest-notarized-sample.pdf

Logistics point: ColdChain rep assigned will be Maria V. (mobile +1-503-555-0198). DocuSign preferred for signer lists; if Redwood sends signers list we will provision courier manifest accordingly.

— Elena Ruiz
Head of Operations, Sterile Infrastructure
[attachment: sterile-courier-sop.pdf] [attachment: manifest-notarized-sample.pdf]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sterile-ops.com>, ColdChain Logistics <logistics@coldchaincouriers.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Courier & Signer Escrow — Signed Bundle Acceptance Protocol

Thanks Elena — that SOP covers most of what we need. A few technical clarifications from infra/ops: 

1) KMS-binding check at acceptance time: Redwood needs the public key thumbprint and a small sample wrapped-key header as Elena requested. We will run an offline verification step (no network required) that validates the KEK wrap header and algorithm identifiers against our on-appliance verifier. The team needs the exact header byte layout so we can add the parser.

2) Manifest contents: please ensure manifest includes SHA256 checksums for each image file and a signed header with UTC timestamp (the notarized sample looks good). We also want a courier-printed QR that maps to the sealed tote ID (human-readable too).

3) Escrow workflow: we prefer option (A) — on-site operator sign + remote escrow reviewer — because it avoids notarization delays for pilot. Remote escrow reviewer will be a compliance account we will provide; that reviewer will countersign (photo + manifest) via DocuSign/secure form.

Mina — can you confirm the compliance reviewer email schema we should use (project-specific reviewer vs global)? Also confirm if we need an SOC2-friendly audit stamp in the manifest.

Jonas — if pilot windows stand, I'll prepare the parser + small acceptance binary and ship it in our sealed USB (with checksums) to the courier manifest so the operator can run pre-install validation.

-Karthik
Lead, Deployment Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sterile-ops.com>, ColdChain Logistics <logistics@coldchaincouriers.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Courier & Signer Escrow — Signed Bundle Acceptance Protocol

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. Plan summary and final asks before we lock pilot: 

Pilot details:
- Site: Sterile Site A (region: us-west)
- Pilot window: 2026-08-24 AM (primary), 2026-08-27 PM (backup)
- Courier: ColdChain (Maria V. onsite contact)

Acceptance flow (agreed):
1) ColdChain photos seal and prints manifest at delivery.
2) On-site operator signs printed manifest and scans photo evidence.
3) Operator runs Redwood acceptance verifier from sealed USB (no network) which validates wrapped-key header and SHA256 checksums.
4) Remote escrow reviewer (Redwood compliance account) receives the photos and manifest PDF and countersigns via DocuSign to complete acceptance.

Final asks (please complete by EOD 2026-08-18):
- Elena / ColdChain: confirm Maria V. contact and courier ID badge numbers.
- ColdChain: confirm they can include a QR on printed manifest that maps to tote ID.
- Elena: confirm notarization add-on available if pilot needs escalation.
- Mina: confirm compliance reviewer email schema and whether SOC2 audit stamp required on manifest.
- Karthik: share the acceptance verifier binary + checksum (will be part of sealed USB).

I've attached the final signer list CSV for DocuSign provisioning. Once DocuSign is set, ColdChain can provision manifest printouts accordingly.

Attachments: docusign-signer-list.csv

Let's target go/no-go check on 2026-08-19 and a dry-run with ColdChain Ops on 2026-08-21.

-Jonas
Director, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference
[attachment: docusign-signer-list.csv]
